data.name: TUTORIAL_1
data.value: Head for the stairway! As you go, you can attack enemies by pressing {0}! Enemies won't move or act until you do.

data.value: You can carry four items. The items you find on the floor have a variety of useful effects.

data.value: You and your partner can hold one item each. Now that you have the Treasure Bag, you can also keep 16 items in your inventory.

data.name: TUTORIAL_11
data.value: Eat an {0} or a Gummi if you get hungry. If you get too hungry, you'll risk fainting before long, so keep an eye on your [color=#FFFF00]Belly[color] in the menu.

data.name: TUTORIAL_12
data.value: Team members will earn Experience Points (Exp. Points) when they defeat an enemy. And they'll level up when they earn enough of them!

data.value: A Pokémon will get more [color=#FFFF00]HP[color], raised stats, and a possible new move each time it levels up. So battle hard to level up more often!

data.value: To earn bonus Exp. Points, a Pokémon must use its moves at least once while battling an enemy, not just its regular {0} attack.
